# Copilot instructions

Whenever you modify this repository, make sure your current model is listed on the `Copilot models used:` line in the root `README.md`. Add it if missing, preserving existing entries and avoiding duplicates.

Whenever you edit a document that already has a `Document version ID:` line, update that ID in the same change, even for formatting-only edits. Use `YYYYMMDD` for the first change to that document on a given day, then `YYYYMMDD-2`, `YYYYMMDD-3`, and so on for additional changes that day. Start again without a suffix on a new day. Do not add a version line to an unversioned document.
